text:
anya: Heads up — found a half-eaten yogurt in the office fridge labelled 'kevin ?' that's definitely 3 weeks old :grimacing:. Tossed it but fridge is kinda a mess. Anyone able to swing by a store and grab oat milk + bagels for tomorrow?

kevin: omg that's mine, sorry 😅 left over from demo day. I can go in ~30 if people chip in for the coffee jar :coffee:

maria: i'll chip $5 in the jar. can pick up oat barista (1L) and an everything bagel pack.

simon: can we standardize labeling? Suggest: initials + date. e.g. `K 2026-03-04`. also maybe a tiny 'discard after 5 days' sticker? :face_with_thermometer:

taco-bot: Kitchen rota reminder — next cleaning due Friday. Assigned: Eng team (kevin, anya).

kevin: can't today, packed with calls. anya, you good to cover and do the run?

anya: I can. leaving at 4:30. I'll grab oat barista, 6 bagels (mixed), small almond butter, and a box of decaf pods (kevin asked). How much should I spend? cash or card?

maria: cash is easiest — leave receipt on the counter. i'll drop $10 in the jar.

simon: cash works. tiny note: don't leave cards unattended near the sink haha :sweat_smile:

anya: cool. picking up at 4:30, ETA back ~5:00. Anyone wants anything else? DM me.

kevin: can you also grab a handful of plain yogurt cups? and put a sticky on the shelf: `Leftovers — 5 days`.

anya: done. posted a sign template in #lunch-plans (copy/paste below):

anya: ```Please label food: Initials • Date • Keep up to 5 days
Example: K 2026-03-10
Leave receipts on the counter.``` 

simon: love this. will print a few and stick them on the shelves.

lunch-ops: Coffee jar balance: $23.00 (updated after maria's contribution)

maria: thanks y'all! :partyparrot: 

anya: quick note — if you label something with a ? we will assume it's abandoned and compost it after 48h :grimacing: 

kevin: fair. will be more diligent. apologies again!
